cumulative.notes: US Operation Epic Fury + Israeli Operation Roaring Lion. As of Mar 24: ~4,500 killed (IDF estimate 4,000–5,000 Iranian soldiers as of Mar 13; midpoint used), 18,551+ injured (Al Jazeera death toll tracker). US: 5,500+ targets hit (LWJ Mar 13). Israeli: 7,600+ strikes in 13 days by Mar 13 (LWJ). 100+ naval vessels destroyed (LWJ Mar 16). Verified killed: Ali Larijani (IDF/Reuters Mar 17), Gholamreza Soleimani/Basij commander (IDF/AP Mar 17-18). Others unconfirmed.

daily.label: 28 Feb
daily.events: Operation Epic Fury begins. Khamenei assassinated. ~900 strikes in first 12 hours targeting IRGC, air defenses, drone sites, airfields, missile sites, naval facilities, nuclear facilities.

daily.label: 1 Mar
daily.events: Most intense day. B-2 stealth bombers strike hardened missile facilities. ~160 killed at girls' school in Minab (near naval base). Chief of Staff Mousavi and former president Ahmadinejad killed.

daily.label: 2 Mar
daily.events: IRGC Malek-Ashtar building in Tehran destroyed. Hezbollah enters conflict. Iran death toll reaches 555.

daily.label: 3 Mar
daily.events: IRIB (state broadcaster) in Tehran struck. Assembly of Experts gathering in Qom struck by Israeli Air Force. IAEA confirms damage at Natanz nuclear facility. ~4,000 targets struck total.

daily.label: 4 Mar
daily.events: Israel at 1,600 strike sorties. Iran death toll surpasses 1,000. ~2,100 military personnel estimated killed.

daily.label: 5 Mar
daily.events: Iran's president apologizes to neighbors, announces ceasefire toward Gulf states unless attacks originate from their territory.

daily.label: 6 Mar
daily.events: Israeli Air Force strikes 400+ targets, drops ~1,465 munitions on regime military sites. Tehran pounded.

daily.label: 7 Mar
daily.events: Continued strikes on military infrastructure across western and central Iran.

daily.label: 8 Mar
daily.events: Israel strikes Iranian oil facilities for first time: Aghdasieh oil warehouse, Tehran refinery, Shahran oil depot, Karaj oil depot. Toxic smoke blankets Tehran. Mojtaba Khamenei named new Supreme Leader.

daily.label: 9 Mar
daily.events: Continued strikes on IRGC missile storage sites in western Iran. Mojtaba Khamenei calls for ceasefire negotiations. US strikes Bandar Abbas port facilities.

daily.label: 10 Mar
daily.events: Reduced tempo as diplomatic channels open. Israeli strikes focus on remaining air defense radars. Iran's acting FM requests UN Security Council emergency session.

daily.label: 11 Mar
daily.events: Continued US/Israeli strikes. LWJ reports US has hit 5,500+ targets total. Iran ballistic launch rate dropped 92% (480→40/day). Drone launch rate dropped from 720→60/day.

daily.label: 12 Mar
daily.events: Dozens of airstrikes target Iran-backed militias across Iraq. 32 PMF HQ strikes since Feb 28 (LWJ). 10 security personnel killed in Tehran checkpoint attacks (Mar 11, per LWJ).

daily.label: 13 Mar
daily.events: Israel shifts to hyperlocal targeting — repression units and regime figures in Tehran. IDF assessment: 4,000-5,000 Iranian soldiers/commanders killed total. 5 Iranians arrested for filming strikes. Israel: 7,600+ total strikes in 13 days (LWJ). Source: LWJ.

daily.label: 14 Mar
daily.events: 15 killed in Isfahan industrial city strike. 20 arrested in NW Iran for alleged Israel cooperation. 10,000+ residential homes damaged/destroyed in Tehran. Source: Al Jazeera Day 16.

daily.label: 15 Mar
daily.events: Cumulative: 1,400+ killed. US Defense Sec claims 15,000 'enemy targets' struck (1,000+ daily). Source: Al Jazeera Day 16.

daily.label: 16 Mar
daily.events: Cumulative: 1,444 killed, 18,551 injured (Al Jazeera Day 17). Iran says missiles are 'from a decade ago' — newer production not yet deployed. Diplomatic channels active.

daily.label: 17 Mar
daily.events: US/Israel expand strikes to gas processing facilities in Asaluyeh and Iranian energy infrastructure. Strikes target IRGC security units, Basij internal security militia positions, police logistics centers, and command nodes. Iran/proxies launch drones and missiles at ports, oil/gas facilities, and US bases in Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Iraq (LWJ Mar 17-19).

daily.label: 18 Mar
daily.events: Israeli strikes kill Ali Larijani (Secretary, Supreme National Security Council), Basij commander Gholamreza Soleimani, and Minister of Intelligence. Iran/proxies continued strikes on GCC countries. Kataib Hezbollah signals possible temporary pause in attacks on US Embassy in Baghdad tied to specific demands (LWJ). Source: LWJ Mar 17-18.

daily.label: 19 Mar
daily.events: Iranian drones and missiles continue hitting regional oil and gas facilities, airports, military bases, and US bases across the Gulf. Targets include Saudi Arabia, UAE (Abu Dhabi area), Qatar (Ras Laffan), Kuwait, and Bahrain. Source: LWJ Mar 17-19.

daily.label: 20 Mar
daily.events: Iran and proxies continue attacking regional airports, energy facilities, military bases, and residential areas in GCC countries and Iraq. Hezbollah strikes in Lebanon and Israel continue (LWJ Mar 20-23).

daily.label: 21 Mar
daily.events: Iranian proxy attacks continue across the region. Strikes hit airports and energy infrastructure. US/Israeli operations continue to degrade Iran's military capabilities (LWJ Mar 20-23).

daily.label: 22 Mar
daily.events: US strikes continue hitting Iran-backed Iraqi militias. Kataib Hezbollah declares temporary ceasefire on attacks targeting US Embassy in Baghdad; other hostilities continue. Israeli forces kill Walid Dib, Hamas money man, in Lebanon, plus two other Hamas members. Israeli strike hits bridge near Qasmiyeh, Lebanon (Reuters/LWJ).

daily.label: 23 Mar
daily.events: Iran threatens to 'completely close' Strait of Hormuz if power plants struck. Iran fires IRGC missiles at Tel Aviv area — confirmed casualties (Al Jazeera Mar 24 liveblog). Iran denies launching long-range missiles at Diego Garcia US/UK base, calls it a 'false flag attack' (Al Jazeera). Claims Iran brought down a US F-35 jet — disputed/unverified. Emergency personnel respond to residential building strike in northern Tehran (Reuters/WANA).

daily.label: 24 Mar
daily.events: Day 25 of war. Trump claims peace negotiations ongoing with Iran; Tehran denies and calls Trump a 'deceitful American president' (IRGC statement). Huge explosions heard in Tehran and other cities; US-Israeli strikes continue despite Trump's peace talk claims. Cumulative: ~1,500 killed in Iran, at least 18 in Israel, 13 US soldiers, 21 killed in Gulf states (Al Jazeera death toll tracker). Source: Al Jazeera, Reuters.
